method: 3 brainstorm agents (mechanism, bilingual kitchen words, short brand), 75 candidates; shortlist checked with iTunes Search (software, US and FR), web search with the trade, and DNS for .com/.app

finalists.name: DemiDemi
finalists.meaning: half the pack now, half later (FR/EN demi)
finalists.web: no exact match; 'Demi AI' calorie app is a different name

finalists.name: Zerest
finalists.meaning: zéro reste / zero + rest: nothing left at the end of the week
finalists.web: no exact match; 'Zorest' calorie app is close in spelling

finalists.name: Restover
finalists.meaning: reste + leftover: the leftover that rolls into the next meal

rejected.name: Lefto
rejected.why: 'Lefto: Payday Budget Planner' on the App Store

rejected.name: Remeal
rejected.why: too close to 'Remeli', an anti-waste meal planning tool

rejected.name: Pakt
rejected.why: several 'Pakt' apps on the App Store

rejected.name: Fridgo
rejected.why: promises fridge inventory, which V1 does not do

rejected.name: Nextover
rejected.why: free, but its meaning (leftover to next) is not obvious in French

rejected.name: Brin
rejected.why: rejected by the user: not tied enough to what the app does

round2_mealoop_variants.context: user likes Mealoop; 'MealLoop AI' (meal photo logging) exists and mealoop.com/.app are registered, so 2 agents produced 40 variants

checked.name: Loopot
checked.meaning: loop + pot: the open pack keeps cooking, pot after pot

checked.name: Mealring
checked.meaning: a closed ring of meals sharing packs

checked.name: Packloop
checked.meaning: the pack loops through the week until finished

checked.name: Platour
checked.meaning: plat + tour: dishes take turns with the same packs

rejected.name: Oomi
rejected.why: 'OOMI: Food Delivery' on the App Store

rejected.name: Mealoop
rejected.why: 'MealLoop AI' exists; confusingly similar; mealoop.com and .app registered
